snippet.title: Death & Taxes - Alpha Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
This is a trailer for the Alpha demo of Death & Taxes Multiplayer RPG, coming for the fall Steam Next Fest.  It will be a single player demo to show off what we've been working on in preparation for Early Access launch targeted for Dec 2026.  

Follow the Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redtigerpro/death-and-taxes-multiplayer-rpg
Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/bXF8BEt
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3960500/Death__Taxes_Multiplayer_RPG
